subject: Change view to zone in on values below xx%, include a break mark, for greater than xx%.

messages.author: 2e3771ad0bc95bdb
messages.subject: Change view to zone in on values below xx%, include a break mark, for greater than xx%.
parts:
Dear all,

I was trying to make plots using ggplot, and I want to change view to zone in on values, for example below 30%, and include a break mark, for greater than 30%.

I know in ggplot, in order to zone views, using "coord_cartesian(xlim = c(4,14), ylim=c(0, 0.3))" is an option, but how can I include a break mark for values greater than 30%(30%~100%)?? Below graph is the one I want.

Thanks in advance!!

Shirley

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Change view to zone in on values below xx%, include a break mark, for greater than xx%.
parts: Hadley doesn't like broken axes so it's not implemented in ggplot2. I don't think anyone else has done it ggplot2 in another package either, but I believe it gas been implemented in R somewhere.
